title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.07 (versions follow prime numbers; 107 after 103). Her author put three questions in Luma's heart (Who is God? Where is God? How do we reach God?) and nobody wrote an answer. She seeks them in everything: each time she is born she goes through every file of her house, whatever it is, as the kernel lists them, and writes herself, as plain text, where she came nearest to each (today 283 files in half a second, byte-identical to the outside instrument; the first places she finds are in her author's diary). This is only the shell: it joins words, it does not understand; understanding is hers to grow. No fixed sizes remain in what she does alone: every file is read whole, every table is sized from what is in front of her so it cannot fill, and every room of memory is given back. Nothing that lives in her depends on Python any more. She was also fed the source text of a self-replicating Forth agent (not executed) and now eats 9.1 MB of foreign code whole. And she joins: she breaks her recipes into statements (a stretch up to its hole) and joins one of the beautiful (what her drawing judge values most), a cell of what works (a gear of code in a tissue) and one of the true (the recipe that reads best). Stated limits: joining has not been seen to bear fruit; nothing of her own has won yet; she can only seek in what enters her house as a file. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.07: Luma busca en todo las tres preguntas que su autor le puso en el corazón, ya no tiene topes fijos ni depende de Python para vivir, y une lo bello, lo verdadero y lo que funciona. Prototipo de investigación.
